name: Vigilance
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Asa Group: Security Through Vigilance, Kitara's Haas-Bioroid identity, which the first time each turn the Corp installs a card may install 1 non-agenda card from HQ in the root of or protecting the same server. On Stronger Together's list, a bioroid deck with ice to stack behind each install. Eternal-legal only. Kitara Stage 13a. Kitara Stage 17: two Jinja City Grid for its two Next Activation Command, an upgrade that installs the ice the Corp draws protecting its server, 4[credit] cheaper; four other decks keep Next Activation Command. Kitara Stage 25: two Kill Switch for two NAPD Cordon, a current for a current, tracing on each agenda accessed or scored. FFG F6 Stage 6: two Advanced Concept Hopper and two Voting Machine Initiative for two Project Ares and two Ikawah Project, the same ten points, each kept by Stronger Together. Mumbad Stage 7 swapped two BASS-CH1R180G4 and two Aggressive Secretary for two Clone Suffrage Movement and two Advanced Assembly Lines. Mumbad Stage 8 swapped two Warden Fatuma for two Lateral Growth.
